sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit: Alibaba's 20B AI Image Editing Model — Semantic ...
sources.snippet: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab open-sources Qwen-Image-Edit, a 20B parameter model enabling text-driven semantic editing, appearance modification, and bilingual text rewriting in images. From style transfer to object manipulation, it redefines what AI image editing can do.

sources.title: qwen-image-edit Model by Qwen | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-Edit is an image editing model with multilingual text editing and strong subject consistency.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit - 千问AI平台
sources.snippet: 千问系列首个图像编辑模型，成功将Qwen-Image的文本渲染能力拓展到编辑任务上。支持精准的中英双语文字编辑、视觉外观与语义双重编辑、具备强大的跨基准性能表现。
